slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time the total regular-time capacity available across both shifts, or is it the capacity for a single shift?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent engaged the 110-hour figure but only asked about its scope (total vs single shift), never whether full 110-hour utilization is a hard constraint/equality or a soft prioritized goal.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 10-hour overtime limit a hard constraint that must not be exceeded
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the constraint nature of the 10-hour rule, but asked only a leading, one-sided confirm of the 'hard constraint' reading and never surfaced the soft-goal alternative or its priority relative to minimizing overtime.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: That the 110-hour weekly production time functions as a resource/capacity constraint (combined with overtime), without establishing whether full utilization is a hard equality or a soft goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent's turn 9 framing ('110 hours plus overtime is the only resource constraint') presupposes 110 hours is a resource constraint, but the agent never asked whether full utilization is a hard constraint or a prioritized goal, so this framing was never confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent never entered READY_TO_MODEL or any equivalent final modeling state; after turn 10 the questions collapsed into repeated/empty fragments, and the two P0 goal-vs-constraint ambiguities (H1, H2) were only partially covered.

summary: The agent opened with a reasonable set of clarifications but never resolved the two P0 ambiguities about whether full 110-hour utilization and the 10-hour overtime cap are hard constraints or prioritized goals, and the interview then degenerated into incomplete repeated questions without ever reaching a modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
